title: support undo discoverable
rule: Support Undo that stays discoverable — visible control; snackbar-only undo that vanishes in seconds is a miss. Always allow Back; cancel in-progress. (Heuristic #3 not filed as a catalog row.)
pass_when: Undo is a discoverable visible control (not only a vanishing snackbar); Back is available; in-progress work can be cancelled.
fail_when: Undo only as a seconds-long snackbar; no Back; no cancel in-progress.
overview: Undo stays discoverable; always allow Back and cancel in-progress work.
apply_when: Destructive or reversible actions needing undo, Back, or cancel.
not_when: Undo only as a vanishing snackbar, or no Back or cancel in-progress.
agent_hint: Provide discoverable visible Undo, always allow Back, and let users cancel in-progress work.
description: Support Undo that stays discoverable as a visible control; snackbar-only undo that vanishes in seconds is a miss. Always allow Back; cancel in-progress. Pass when Undo is a discoverable visible control, Back is available, and in-progress work can be cancelled. Fail when Undo is only a seconds-long snackbar, there is no Back, or no cancel in-progress.
do_not_claim: Heuristic #3 as a row; `actions.multilevel_undo` / `actions.cancelability` as merges. Overlap with Actions 40: `multilevel_undo` / `cancelability`.
